title: Asset redeemed
description: This event occurs when the funds in an asset are withdrawn.

redemption_id.title: Redemption ID
redemption_id.description: Unique redemption identifier generated by Pismo platform

asset_id.title: Asset ID
asset_id.description: Unique asset identifier defined by client. This is part of the asset identifier on the Pismo platform. It can be used to make redemptions and cancellations.

issuer_id.title: Issuer ID
issuer_id.description: Cetip code of registrator of asset. This is part of the asset identifier on the Pismo platform. It needs to be in every API call. An organization can have multiple issuer IDs.

document_number.title: Document number
document_number.description: Number of asset quota owner's legal document

external_id.title: External ID
external_id.description: External identifier for operation. Optional field provided by client in asset redemption operation.

redeemed_units.title: Redeemed units
redeemed_units.description: Number of units redeemed from asset quotas in redemption process

deposit_number.title: Deposit number of the asset quota
deposit_number.description: Optional attribute provided by client when registering asset quota on Pismo platform

created_at.title: Created date
created_at.description: Creation date of redemption on Pismo platform

redeemed_unit_value.title: Asset unit value received from API
redeemed_unit_value.description: Unit value redeemed received from API

operation_code.title: Operation code
operation_code.description: Optional attribute generated when redeeming on Pismo platform
